guides.favoredWhen: She outranges and outscales you. Concede the 1v1, answer with E, and win on roams.

keyTips.text: She outranges and outscales: concede the 1v1, win elsewhere.
When you E in, she double-Ws Q-E backwards: expect the retreat combo.
She shoves when you ult away: your roam costs plates.

tips.text: Take care early: her range beats yours from level 1.
Farm under tower: concede CS before HP.
Ult away only on crashed waves: she shoves every roam.
All-in with jungle: your E needs help to stick.
Roams converted plus lane conceded: the Akali who never dove you never wins.

sources.rankClaim: Master (profile badge; title claims 2000LP GrandMaster EUW and Challenger EUNE) · Akali main

guides.favoredWhen: She pokes constantly and you cannot engage solo. Shield up, farm, and roam on shove.

keyTips.text: She pokes you constantly and you cannot engage her alone: respect her mobility plus Charm.
Dodge her Charm and the true-damage return of her Q: sidestep both halves.
Go Doran's Shield plus Second Wind: farm, play safe, play with your jungler.

tips.text: Concede the early poke: DShield plus potions outlast her mana.
Trade on your Q (about {cd:3:Q}): the cooldown is your window.
When her Charm is spent, all-in: E dash into W taunt.
Her W speed answers your E: bait before committing.
Farmed plus roamed: you outscale her and kill her easily later.

guides.favoredWhen: She dictates every trade and her poke is free. Survive it, call friends, and tax her roams.

keyTips.text: She dictates every trade: concede the poke, contest the map.
Her Aery poke is free against your kit: concede early CS to stay healthy.
Your gank setup is the threat: weak laners call friends.

tips.text: She establishes poke dominance early: you cannot answer.
Give CS, keep HP: her poke only matters if it sticks.
Her shoves answer your roams: crash before you move.
She scales greedy with First Strike: trade into it to spoil the banks.
Setup converted plus poke survived: the Syndra who never killed you never carries.

guides.favoredWhen: He outranges and outscales you. Weather the poke, bait his E answers, and convert roams.

keyTips.text: He outranges and outscales: never his melee, always your patience.
His double-W Q-E backwards answers your E: expect retreating damage every engage.
Keep CS and XP even or better: parity now denies his sidelane later.

early-lane.text: Zed often places Living Shadow before Death Mark so he can swap away from skillshots. Hold your crowd control until he has used the swap.

win-condition.text: Death Mark always lands Zed behind his target. Pre-aim crowd control and escapes behind you, not toward where he cast it.

tips.text: He pokes and backs off: never follow into extended fighting.
His backwards WEQ answers every E: no exceptions, so bait first.
Death Mark always lands Zed behind his target. Pre-aim crowd control and escapes behind you, not toward where he cast it.
When you ult away, he shoves: your roam is his CS lead.
Roams converted plus parity kept: the Zed who never sidelaned you never ends it.

keyTips.text: Lane safely by collecting minions and punishing opponent mistakes instead of forcing early duels.
Expect ranged mid laners to pressure Galio before he can reach them with engage.
Join skirmishes over holding side lanes, since control plus the ultimate can flip an ally fight.

tips.text: Call the jungler when an opening shows; knock-up into taunt sets up the gank.
Max Q in a solo lane to reset the passive faster, add percentage-health damage, and clear waves sooner.
Shove the wave under the enemy turret with Q and passive hits, then look to roam.
Weave Colossal Smash between spells whenever possible, since landed abilities shorten its cooldown and skipped hits waste damage.
Run the realistic engage of E knock-up into a passive hit, W taunt, Q, and another passive hit.
Take Flash default with Ghost second for sticking or escaping, or Teleport for hard lanes and faster joins.
Turn pushed waves into first moves toward teammates and river plays across his wave-pressure, roam, invade, and teamfight strengths.
Respect long cooldowns by valuing haste; after an early engage dump, little remains until spells return.
Stack haste and cycle the passive reset to sustain damage and control through fights.
Drop Hero's Entrance to shield an ally or flip a fight by knocking up nearby enemies.
Choose each fight between locking opponents down and peeling a carry through layered control.
Layer Shield of Durand taunts on groups with Justice Punch and Hero's Entrance knock-ups.
Never default to split-pushing; teamfights carry far more of his value.
Stay useful while behind purely through engage, protection, and control.

itemization.text: Run Aftershock with Shield Bash, Second Wind, and Overgrowth, plus Nimbus Cloak and Transcendence.
Build Abyssal Mask, Mercury's Treads, Imperial Mandate, Zhonya's Hourglass, Riftmaker, and Jak'Sho.
Rush Ionian Boots as a cheap early spike for long cooldowns; swap Mercury's Treads into magic damage or control, Steelcaps into basic-attack threats, and Sorcerer's Shoes for damage builds.
Rate Abyssal Mask highly for its low cost, defensive stats, and nearby-enemy magic-damage amplification.
Add Cosmic Drive for health, AP, haste, and movement speed behind repeated spell and passive cycles.
Pick Dusk and Dawn as the AP-bruiser spellblade, or Fimbulwinter from an early Tear for mana, health, and haste.
